generatedFrom: live run in the in-app Chromium browser at 1920x1000

director.method: fired in sequence without an intervening system.reset; measures that every declared event acts
director.seeTestReportFor: per-event measurement after system.reset, which records 18 events with no store effect of their own

yieldRule.mechanism: concepts ask PMXQFlow.pending(svc, tid), never view[tid].surfacesYielded, because update() renders work surfaces before the question
yieldRule.workSurfaces: hidden while a question is pending; state continues underneath and returns intact including the open group
yieldRule.artifactHandoff: stays - it is the work's product, not a work surface
yieldRule.bsdAdviceReason: in t2/t6/t7/t8 advice is a member of the cluster by design (chip, exec row, status-card link, gutter dot), so it cannot outlive its container without inventing a second surface
yieldRule.release: PMXQFlow.release() clears the flag on both submit and cancel

measured.method: each concept loaded fresh with cleared persistence, counted while the fixture questionnaire was pending, resolved through its own controls, counted again
notLeaks: t2 keeps one per-turn transcript chip (activity) which belongs to a message, not the cluster; the work-surface host holds zero chips while pending
t6 shows no bsd row after resolving because the log is condensed to its +N steps row; expanding it renders twelve rows ending in bsd

note: Re-run after the post-Phase-E audit added the `forms` suite (the eight question systems, the eight work clusters, the yield rule and the PMXQFlow verb contract) and pinned the swapText contract. The audit found two defects: t2 leaked a partial chip run past the yield, and motion.swapText painted an empty frame when writing a FIRST value. Both fixed; suite and full matrix re-verified.
